title: Local Christmas tree lot expects boost in sales following Thanksgiving holiday - NewsBreak
text:
By Michael Doti ,
1 days ago
ROANOKE, Va. ( WFXR ) – Sweet Providence Christmas Tree Lot is one of many lots expected to see a rise in sales in the next few days.
“That’s usually what happens pretty much every year, and it’s been slow and fast at certain times, but it’s usually slower before Thanksgiving,” Emory Kemp, one of the workers at Sweet Providence, said. “Probably come Friday, even halfway through Friday, we’ll probably lose most, if not all, the trees that’ll be currently here, and they’ll be bought up.”
Some folks have already gotten a head start, like the Dickey family.
“We thought it’d be fun to get a Christmas tree because we’re already putting up some Christmas decorations while we were there,” Elanor Dickey said.” “They decided we should get a Christmas tree.”
“This year we’ve got a few things going on right after Thanksgiving,” Randy Dickey said.
“Maybe, we might not have time after Thanksgiving, so we decided we could get it today,” Bill Dickey added.
The Dickey family’s tree is just one of an estimated 25-30 million real trees to be purchased this holiday season.
Sweet Providence has an assortment of options, including White Pines, Concolor Firs and Norway Spruces, which all have their pros, such as unique scents and good branches for holding ornaments. However, Kemp said he expects Fraser Firs to be the go-to trees once again.
“For the one that’s going to have the best options for features like maintaining a retention of water and needles, that’s going to be the Fraser Fir for the most part,” he said. “That’s also going to be the vast majority of our product.”
The lot will remain open seven days a week until Christmas Day. People can also get wreaths, Christmas tree stands and hats at the lot.
